s3.dialog_review_sub: Tasks with the most incorrect answers
s3.guidance_default: The best next step is to return to the home screen — it's easier to choose what to do next without searching.
s3.guidance_with_errors: Complex completed. Return home to choose your next action, then reinforce weak spots via the calendar or review.
s3.guidance_high_rate: Strong run. On the home screen you'll most quickly decide whether to continue with a new complex or a short review.
s3.guidance_some_progress: Progress made. The next reasonable step is to open the home screen and choose what to reinforce today.
s3.guidance_theory_with_errors: Complex completed. Return to the theory to check your mistakes against the material and continue the cycle.
s3.guidance_theory_no_errors: Complex completed. The related material is already known, so you can return directly to the theory.
s3.review_loading_sub: Loading the same reviews shown after incorrect answers.
s3.review_unavailable_sub: Errors are listed, but detailed review materials were not saved.
s3.review_card_note: Review compiled from all complex iterations.
s3.review_no_details: An error count was saved for this task, but detailed answers were not.
s3.toast_no_session: Results screen opened without a sessionId. Return to the session and open results again.
s3.toast_results_unavailable: Final results are temporarily unavailable. Try opening the screen again.

calendar.daily_mix_rest_day_reason: Today is marked as a rest day, so no mandatory reviews.

calendar.welcome_text: Your activity will appear here. Start completing complexes to track progress.

calendar.health_subline_some_critical: These complexes need a short review.
